role: Per-user overnight HRV baseline: keeps one data point per night (max 90) persisted to HRVBaseline.json, derives a display baseline over the 7 most recent stored nights (geometric-mean RMSSD etc.) and ln(RMSSD) z-score stats over the last 60 stored nights for recovery scoring, gating which sessions may enter. Also exposes the baseline's night selection as static functions (isBaselineCandidate, baselineRMSSDs) so the daily report's baseline counts exactly the nights the score counts.
types: BaselineTracker: class (@unchecked Sendable, NSRecursiveLock-protected) — baseline store and statistics
BaselineTracker.Baseline: struct Codable — display baseline snapshot over the 7 most recent stored nights (minimumSamples=3)
BaselineTracker.BaselineDeviation: struct Codable — per-metric % deviation of a session vs baseline
BaselineTracker.RecoveryBaselineStats: struct — ln(RMSSD) mean/SD/7-night CV + HR mean/SD for z-scores (minimumDays=3)
BaselineTracker.BaselineDataPoint: private struct Codable — one stored night incl. window-quality fields for replacement
BaselineTracker.StoredData: private struct Codable — on-disk wrapper {baseline, historicalData}
state: file:<baselineFile> — HRVBaseline.json in the App Group container (or Documents) for the app via init(onBaselineUpdated:), any URL via init(baselineFile:onBaselineUpdated:) (JSON iso8601, .atomic + completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication)
file:HRVBaseline.json.corrupt (quarantine copy of an undecodable baseline file)
mem:BaselineTracker.baselineWindowDays (static let 7 — the 7 most recent stored nights for the display baseline and the 7-day CV)
mem:BaselineTracker.onBaselineUpdated (injected (rmssd, hr) closure; production wiring RRCollector.swift:647 → SettingsManager.updateBaseline)
mem:BaselineTracker.recoveryWindowNights (static let 60 — nights the recovery score's baseline reads; also ReportBaselineNights.count and the coach report's night limit)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: fileManager = FileManager.default, lock = NSRecursiveLock(), historicalData = []. Class is @unchecked Sendable relying on manual lock discipline. Static constants baselineWindowDays=7, maxHistoricalPoints=90, recoveryWindowNights=60.

units.does: Convenience init for the app: resolves AppConfig.sharedContainerURL()/HRVBaseline.json, logs the container path, and delegates to init(baselineFile:onBaselineUpdated:).
reads: file:<AppGroup or Documents>/HRVBaseline.json (via the designated init)

units.does: Stores the callback and baselineFile, loads stored data, recomputes the display baseline from the stored nights (not trusting the saved one), pushes it to the callback when it has >= 3 nights, and logs counts.
Returns currentBaseline under the lock (the 7-calendar-day display baseline, may be nil).
True when a currentBaseline exists and its sampleCount >= 3.

branches.effect: returns false; otherwise returns sampleCount >= Baseline.minimumSamples (3)

units.does: Returns the number of stored nights (historicalData.count, max 90), not limited to the 7-day window.
Returns ln(RMSSD) z-score stats over all stored nights (last 60 by count) — the 'show' baseline including tonight.
Returns z-score stats computed only from stored nights whose SleepSchedule.nightKey is strictly earlier than the session's night, so a night is never scored against itself or later nights.
Takes up to the last recoveryWindowNights (60) points, converts to ln(RMSSD), and builds RecoveryBaselineStats; nil below 3 points or 3 positive RMSSD values.

branches.effect: returns nil (no z-score baseline); else continues with suffix(60)

branches.cond: fewer than 3 positive-RMSSD values among the last 60

units.does: Maps points to ln(rmssd), dropping points with rmssd <= 0.
Builds RecoveryBaselineStats: ln-mean, SD = max(widenedLnSD, 0.10 floor), 7-night CV, HR mean and SD floored at 0.5, daysInWindow = count of ln values, lastDataPointDate = last point date.
Sample SD of ln values multiplied by sqrt(7/n) when n < 7 (1.0 at n >= 7), widening small-sample SD; shared by DailyLoopAnalysis and TrendAnalysis+Verdict.

branches.effect: widening = 1.0; else sqrt(7/count) (≈1.53 at 3). Count 0 would give sqrt(7/0)=inf × 0 = NaN, but no caller passes 0: stats(from:) and DailyLoopAnalysis guard >= 3 (DailyLoopAnalysis.swift:225), TrendAnalysis passes its earlier group which is >= 2 (TrendAnalysis+Verdict.swift:52,114)

units.does: Coefficient of variation (×100) of ln(RMSSD) over the 7 most recent stored nights (the same count-based window as the display baseline, baselineWindowDays); nil with < 7 points or < 3 positive values.

branches.cond: fewer than 3 positive RMSSD among last 7
branches.effect: returns nil; else CV×100 (nil if mean ln is 0)

units.does: Filters sessions to complete overnight analysed HRV-reliable ones and sorts oldest-first; then, under one hold of the lock, merges each through merge(_:sleepSchedule:) and, if any was admitted, commits once (sort, trim, recalculate, notify, one file write); logs counts inside the lock.

branches.effect: logs and returns without touching state

units.does: Rebuild filter: state == .complete, sessionType == .overnight, analysisResult present and isReliableForHRVAggregates.

Static: whether a session can hold a baseline night — isRebuildCandidate (complete, overnight, analyzed, isReliableForHRVAggregates), isStructurallySoundForBaseline on its analysis result, and a measured (not estimated) SDNN: what rebuildFromSessions admits through admitsToBaseline. Used by baselineRMSSDs and by the report night readers (ReportBaselineNights, WorkoutRecorder+Metrics.recentOvernightSessions) to count baseline nights.

branches.cond: not a rebuild candidate or no analysisResult

units.does: Static, lock-free: replays the canonical baseline selection over `sessions` for the night of `session`. Keeps isBaselineCandidate sessions whose nightKey is before the session's night, sorts them by start, builds each one's data point and merges it into its night slot with mergeIntoNight (same replacement rule as the stored baseline), then returns the RMSSD of the last recoveryWindowNights (60) nights, oldest first — the nights recoveryBaselineStats(excludingNightOf:) would read on a tracker rebuilt from the same sessions. Non-positive RMSSDs are returned as is (the caller drops them, as stats(from:) does).

branches.cond: candidate and night before the session's
branches.effect: kept; else dropped (incl. the session's own night and later nights)

units.does: Structural baseline gate: isStructurallySound(result:sessionDuration:) with the session's duration (end ?? start minus start).

branches.effect: duration 0, so the span and 3 h tests fail unless the window is long enough and recovery organized

units.does: True when the analysed span — the window (windowEndMs − windowStartMs) or, with no window, the whole session — is at least forReliableWindowMs (300 s), and either recovery was organized or the session lasted at least forOvernightSessionSeconds (3 h).

branches.effect: span = window length; else span = sessionDuration

units.does: Under the lock: merge(_:sleepSchedule:) (gate + night slot); when admitted, commitChanges() (sort, trim to 90, recalculate, notify, save).

branches.cond: merge returns false (no analysisResult or not admitted)

units.does: When the session has an analysisResult and passes admitsToBaseline, merges its data point into its night slot of historicalData (static mergeIntoNight) and returns true; else false. Caller holds the lock.
Sorts historicalData by date, keeps the newest 90 points, recalculates the display baseline, notifies the callback and saves to disk. Caller holds the lock.

branches.effect: keeps only the newest 90 points (oldest dropped permanently)

units.does: Four gates: overnight sessionType, isReliableForHRVAggregates (not .insufficient/.preSleep), isStructurallySoundForBaseline (each logging its rejection), and an SDNN that is not an estimate (a data point's SDNN is a stored number the SDNN baseline averages).
Builds a BaselineDataPoint from the session (start/end dates) and analysis result (time-domain, frequency-domain, DFA, ANS metrics, window quality fields).

Static over the `nights` array it is given (historicalData for the stored baseline, a local array for baselineRMSSDs): finds an existing point with the same SleepSchedule.nightKey; appends when none, otherwise replaces it only if shouldReplace says so.

branches.cond: no existing point for this night

branches.effect: overwrites the existing slot; false → new point discarded

returns whether the new one is the morning reading; else objective comparison

units.does: % deviations of the session's RMSSD, SDNN, HR, HF, LF/HF, stress, readiness from the current display baseline (7 most recent stored nights) via deviation(of:against:); nil without a baseline of >= 3 nights or without analysis. A night already admitted is part of that baseline; deviation(for:sleepSchedule:) excludes it.

units.does: BaselineDeviation of result vs baseline (percent per metric); sdnnDeviation nil when the result's SDNN is an estimate; nil overall when baseline.sampleCount < 3.
Clears currentBaseline and historicalData under the lock and saves the empty state to disk.
Static: mean of values, nil when empty.
Replacement decision ladder: consolidation verdict, then organized-recovery verdict, then artifact/HR-stability gates, then a >5% readiness improvement.
If existing consolidated and new not: new must beat existing readiness by > 15% of existing. If new consolidated and existing not: replace when new readiness >= 90% of existing. Else nil.
Only when consolidation status is equal: rejects a non-organized new vs organized existing; accepts organized new vs non-organized existing when readiness >= 95% of existing; else nil.

branches.cond: consolidation status differs (nil treated false on both sides)

branches.effect: treated as 0; else falls through to nil

units.does: Rejects the new window when its artifact % exceeds max(1.5×existing, 2.0); then applies the HR-stability check.
Rejects when new window HR CV > 1.3× existing; passes when either value missing.

branches.effect: returns true; else logs and returns false

units.does: Returns true when new readiness exceeds existing by more than 5% of existing (nil scores treated as 0).

branches.effect: logs and returns true; else logs and returns false

units.does: Sets currentBaseline to makeBaseline over the 7 most recent stored nights (by count, so a gap in recording does not empty or shrink it); nil when nothing is stored.
Display Baseline over the given points: geometric-mean RMSSD, arithmetic SDNN/HR, optional means of HF/LF/LF-HF/DFA/stress/readiness, sampleCount = point count, date = now; nil for no points.
exp(mean(ln rmssd)) over positive RMSSD values; arithmetic mean when none are positive.
